name: Way of Pain
tagline: Welcome the strikes of your enemies, and let them shape you. Your capacity for suffering is bottomless.

features.name: Bring the Pain
features.text: Damage no longer causes you to lose Momentum. (1/round) You may take 1 Wound to gain 10 Momentum for free.

action.name: Bring the Pain
action.text: (1/round) You may take 1 Wound to gain 10 Momentum for free.

features.manualNote: Momentum is no longer lost when you take damage: don’t clear it when you are hit (the sheet still clears it on damage). To use the free option, mark 1 Wound and add 10 Momentum by hand.

source.note: The Momentum resource lists damageTaken in “lose”; there is no effect type to remove that trigger, so the player must restore Momentum by hand until the engine supports it.

features.name: Share My Pain
features.text: (1/round) Whenever you take damage, you can take half as much, and deal that much to another creature within Reach.
features.manualNote: Once per round when you take damage, halve it and tell the GM to deal that amount to another creature within Reach.

source.note: FAQ (PDF 8, printed 14): the damage from Share My Pain can be Defended or otherwise reduced, which also reduces the damage you deal in return.

features.name: Pain Sharpens the Mind
features.text: While you are Bloodied, gain advantage.

source.note: The text does not say which rolls gain advantage (all rolls? attacks only?), so it is not automated. Asked in the report.

features.name: Echoed Agony
features.text: Your Share My Pain can also target a 2nd creature within Reach 4.
features.manualNote: Share My Pain can also deal its damage to a 2nd creature within Reach 4.

name: Way of Iron
tagline: Train your body to be hard as iron. Concentrate to strengthen your defenses, then release the energy for devastating blows.

features.name: Steel Yourself
features.text: When you roll Initiative gain Tempered: (1/round) reduce an attack’s damage by 10 for free. When you hit, you may end Tempered to add 1d20 damage.
features.manualNote: Once per round, reduce an attack’s damage against you by 10 by hand. When you end Tempered for +1d20 damage, spend the Tempered resource.

source.note: Tempered is tracked as a 1-point resource (have it or not) gained on Initiative. The book doesn’t say Tempered ends at the end of combat, so no “lose” trigger is set.

features.name: Iron Fists
features.text: When you end Tempered, roll its d20 with advantage.
features.manualNote: When you end Tempered, roll the 1d20 twice and keep the higher.

features.name: Iron Body
features.text: You can double the Tempered damage reduction each round or use it 2/round. Gain Tempered the first time you would gain a Wound each encounter.

effects.text: Iron Body: the first time you would gain a Wound this encounter, gain Tempered.

features.manualNote: Each round choose: Tempered reduces damage by 20 once, or by 10 twice. The first time you would gain a Wound each encounter, set Tempered back to 1.

features.name: Infuse with Iron
features.text: When you use Infuse Strength, your target gains Tempered.
features.manualNote: Tell the target of your Infuse Strength that they gain Tempered.

features.name: Perfect Alloy
features.text: Gain Tempered whenever you use a Burst of Speed.
features.manualNote: When you spend a Burst of Speed, set Tempered to 1.

name: Way of Hurricanes
tagline: Your fist is as the howling wind, unceasing and everflowing. Those who face you are battered and bruised by a whirlwind of deadly strikes.

features.name: Cyclone
features.text: (Reach 4) You may spend 1 Momentum to move a creature 1 space.
features.manualNote: Spend 1 Momentum by hand to move a creature within Reach 4 by 1 space.

features.name: Cleaving Gale
features.text: Whenever you crit, you may deal that much damage to a 2nd creature within Reach 1 of your target. (1/turn) When you HIT, you may gain a Wound to change it into a crit.
features.manualNote: On a crit, deal the same damage to a 2nd creature within Reach 1 of your target. Once per turn on a hit, mark a Wound to make it a crit.

features.name: Hurricane Strike
features.text: Your Galeforce Strike may gain: AoE, Reach 1.
features.manualNote: Galeforce Strike can be made as an AoE with Reach 1.

features.name: Sidestep
features.text: After you are attacked, you may move 2 spaces (after damage resolves).
features.manualNote: After an attack against you resolves, you may move 2 spaces.

features.name: Forceful Gust
features.text: Your Unarmed Strikes can Knockback STR spaces; you may suffer 1 Wound to double the distance.
features.manualNote: Push the target of an Unarmed Strike STR spaces; mark 1 Wound to double it.

features.name: Tempest’s Fury
features.text: Whenever you would roll any extra dice for a crit, instead roll 1d20.
features.manualNote: Replace the extra crit dice with a single 1d20.

name: Way of Flame
tagline: Burn fiercely with the heat of battle, fight fast and reckless, and counter enemies with burning strikes.

features.name: Exploding Soul
features.text: Whenever you gain one or more Wounds, make an Unarmed Strike, dealing the damage to ALL others within Reach 1. (1/round) On your turn, you may suffer a Wound.

effects.text: Exploding Soul: make an Unarmed Strike, dealing the damage to ALL others within Reach 1.

features.manualNote: When you gain Wounds, roll an Unarmed Strike and apply it to all others within Reach 1. Once per round on your turn, you may mark a Wound.

source.note: FAQ (PDF 8, printed 14): Exploding Soul can cause more Wounds while Dying if you fail the STR save on attacks while Dying.

features.name: Burning Palm
features.text: Your Unarmed Strikes gain: On crit: Smoldering. You may double the effects of Momentum vs Smoldering creatures (ending the condition).
features.manualNote: On an Unarmed Strike crit, the target becomes Smoldering. Against a Smoldering creature you may double Momentum’s effects, which ends Smoldering.

features.name: Chain Reaction
features.text: (1/turn) When you crit with an Unarmed Strike, deal fire damage equal to your STR+Momentum spent to creatures of your choice adjacent to your target. Repeat any number of times, targeting creatures not yet damaged by this effect this turn.
features.manualNote: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike crit, deal STR + Momentum spent as fire damage to chosen creatures adjacent to the target, chaining to creatures not yet damaged this turn.

features.name: Encompassing Flames
features.text: You may double the Reach of Chain Reaction and Exploding Soul.
features.manualNote: Chain Reaction and Exploding Soul may use double Reach.
